S1 — BLOCKING (P2): independent save-advantage effects drop the printed restriction to the item's particular trapping saving throw.
Invariant/authority: USER's faithful-or-absent decision, owning .19.4.5 DESIGN/AC1/AC3, ADR 0020 source fidelity and the printed item descriptions require every typed effect to preserve its selected roll scope and qualifying predicate exactly, or be withheld with a verbatim adjudicated span. Profile rules-clause-complete; owner .19.4.5. A separate correct save payload or an importer-only source phrase cannot qualify an independent modifier with no reference to that payload. This is a surviving source-qualification sibling, not whole-item completeness or a demand for an executor.

Confirmed membership and scenarios:
1. magic-item:iron-flask / c2-residual-iron-flask-known-save. Producer packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:326-330; emitted packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json:107908. Typed: advantage, roll=Wisdom saving throw, condition=target has been trapped by this flask before. Printed p.228: after the DC 17 Wisdom save to avoid being trapped, a previously trapped target has advantage on THE saving throw. The typed effect retains history but does not restrict the modified roll to the flask's trapping save. Distinguishing scenario: that previously trapped creature, even while selected as the flask's target, makes a Wisdom save against an unrelated hold person spell. Its history condition and typed roll category are satisfied, but the item source grants advantage only on the flask save, not the unrelated spell save.
2. magic-item:mirror-of-life-trapping / c2-residual-mirror-known-save. Same producer :383-387; records.json:110442. Typed: advantage, roll=Charisma saving throw, condition=creature knows mirror's nature. Printed p.230: THIS saving throw (DC 15 to avoid the mirror's extradimensional cell) is made with advantage if the creature knows the mirror's nature. Distinguishing scenario: a knowledgeable creature makes a Charisma save against banishment, including while standing within 30 feet of the activated mirror. The emitted condition and roll category are satisfied; the printed mirror rule grants no advantage on banishment.

Boundary/evidence: both modifiers are independent effects with their own effects-block readiness clauses. Recursive walks find each ID ONLY at its own mechanics.effects[].id and its readiness representation.effectId. No operation, state, curse, containment or other effect references either modifier or binds it to the corresponding trap-save effect. Both correct neighboring trap-save payloads therefore do not restore the missing roll relation. The sourcePhrases are used only for producer validation and are not emitted as modifier predicates. lookup_rules returns these positive typed claims to the DM; no current deterministic executor for these effects is alleged. This is a model-facing source disagreement with real bounded authority, not a speculative engine failure. The actual lexical screen returns violations=[] for both, consistent with its disclosed necessary-but-insufficient scope.

Broad Protection/Luck/Archmagi modifiers genuinely have their printed broader scopes. Mirror construct automatic success explicitly names mirror trapping, so it is not this loss. Exactly two confirmed carriers are batched.
